business_summary: Mochida Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals and healthcare products in Japan. The company offers pharmaceuticals products for the treatment of cardiovascular, obstetrics, gynecology, dermatologists, psychiatry, and gastroenterological, including Realda and Collagen for the treatment of ulcerative colitis; Goofis and Movicol for the treatment of chronic constipation; interstitial pulmonary hypertension for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension; Treprospermid, for pulmonary hypertension associated with ulcerative lung disease; Uris, for gout and hyperuricemia; and Clorox, for ulcerative colitis; Epadel for hyperlipidemia and obstructive arteriosclerosis; Treprost for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension and pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease; Atelec, a calcium channel blocker antihypertensive drug; Heparin Na anticoagulants; and Onboard, ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease treatment agents. In addition, it develops medical devices, including dMD-002, which is used for the treatment of cavernous nerve injury; and dMD-003 for adhesion prevention material. Further, the company engages in the development, production, distribution, sale, and marketing of skincare products, as well as academic research and marketing. Mochida Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1913 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 모치다제약(Mochida Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.)은 일본에서 의약품 및 헬스케어 제품을 제조 및 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 궤양성 대장염 치료를 위한 Realda 및 Collagen을 포함하여 심혈관, 산부인과, 피부과, 정신과, 위장병 치료를 위한 의약품을 제공합니다. 만성 변비 치료를 위한 구피스(Goofis) 및 모비콜(Movicol); 폐동맥 고혈압 치료를 위한 간질성 폐고혈압; 궤양성 폐질환과 관련된 폐고혈압 치료를 위한 Treprospermid; 통풍 및 고요산혈증을 위한 Uris; 궤양성 대장염의 경우 Clorox; 고지혈증 및 폐쇄성 동맥경화증용 에파델; 폐동맥고혈압 및 간질성 폐질환과 관련된 폐고혈압 치료를 위한 트레프로스트(Treprost); 칼슘채널차단제 항고혈압제인 아텔렉(Atelec); 헤파린 Na 항응고제; 기내에는 궤양성 대장염 및 크론병 치료제가 포함되어 있습니다. 또한 해면상 신경 손상 치료에 사용되는 dMD-002, 유착방지재로는 dMD-003 등이 있다. 또한 회사는 개발에 참여하고 있습니다.
